user.title: Matrix Server
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Matrix homeserver.

data_description.account_label: Short name for this account. Used as prefix in service names. Allowed: lowercase letters, digits, underscores (max. 30). Other characters are converted automatically (e.g. spaces and - become _).

credentials_token.title: Access Token
credentials_token.description: You can find your access token in your Matrix client under Settings → Security → Sessions.

rooms.title: Matrix Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms are optional. Bridge accounts (WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram) do not need rooms – the 'Send direct message' service is sufficient.

data.enable_sync: Enable background sync (required to receive replies)

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description:
The access token for {username} has expired or was revoked. Please enter a new token.

On servers using the Matrix Authentication Service (MAS), tokens copied from Element expire quickly. Issue a long-lived token with `mas-cli manage issue-compatibility-token <username>`.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Matrix server. Please check the URL and credentials.
error.label_in_use: This label is already used by another account. Please choose a different one.
error.invalid_url: Invalid homeserver URL. Please use something like 'https://matrix.example.org'.
error.invalid_label: The label must contain at least one letter or digit (e.g. 'marc').
error.invalid_auth: The access token is invalid, expired or was revoked.
error.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different Matrix account than this entry.

abort.already_configured: This Matrix instance is already configured.
